title: All 15 Webots scenarios passed
summary: This CI run tested the merged PR #132 ("FEAT: add more webots scenarios") on the dev branch. All 15 scenarios across builtin, cap, and flow families passed with a 100% pass rate. The PR adds four new Webots worlds (apartment, break_room, complete_apartment, kitchen) and makes the simulation launch configurable via ROBONIX_WEBOTS_WORLD and ROBONIX_WEBOTS_ROBOT environment variables. The Dockerfile and entrypoint were updated to support these new worlds, and the ROS 2 launch file was modified to accept world and robot arguments.
pr_changes: Added 4 new Webots world files: apartment.wbt, break_room.wbt, complete_apartment.wbt, kitchen.wbt
Added corresponding .wbproj and .jpg files for each new world
Modified examples/webots/sim/bridge/Dockerfile to improve Webots deb download robustness
Modified examples/webots/sim/bridge/entrypoint.sh to accept ROBONIX_WEBOTS_WORLD and ROBONIX_WEBOTS_ROBOT env vars
Modified examples/webots/sim/compose.yaml to pass ROBONIX_WEBOTS_WORLD and ROBONIX_WEBOTS_ROBOT env vars
Modified examples/webots/sim/ros_ws/src/eaios_webots/setup.py to use glob for launch and world files
Modified examples/webots/sim/start.sh to support --world and --robot CLI arguments
test_result: The CI ran 15 scenarios: 4 builtin (fault_recovery_builtin, file_roundtrip, plan_control_builtins, run_command), 7 cap (camera_snapshot, explore_smoke, lidar_snapshot, mapping_save, memory_roundtrip, scene_object_fixture, speech_speak, voiceprint_list), and 4 flow (fault_recovery, object_navigation, patrol_observe). All passed. The explore skill timed out as expected (5s and 8s ceilings). Navigation succeeded. Scene perception detected objects (potted plant, robot).
